en.io: Accepts natural language image or design descriptions as input and outputs detailed, structured English prompts.
en.boundary: It only constructs and optimizes textual prompts and visual rules, without rendering or outputting actual image or video media.
scenarios: Generating standard realistic portrait photography prompts
Creating complex action and style prompts for specific anime or historical characters
Drafting graphic design and poster prompts with precise style and color specifications

zh.io: 接收用户的自然语言图像或设计需求描述，输出结构化扩充后的英文专业提示词。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责构建与优化文本提示词及设计规则，不直接渲染或输出实际图片与视频文件。
scenarios: 生成写实人像摄影类提示词
生成包含特定动漫/IP角色与复杂动作特效的跨域场景提示词
生成具备特定配色与排版规范的视觉设计海报提示词
